title: In The Sangat, The Holy Congregation
summary: The shabad does not leave mercy at diagnosis. It turns toward return.
takeaway: in the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, the bitter becomes sweet
lifeApplication: Receive one line as mercy before turning it into a performance review. After the reaction, make the next return smaller and truer.

source.shortMeaning: The Lord, the Supreme Lord God, is Inaccessible and Unfathomable. Those who are committed; in the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, the bitter becomes sweet
source.lifeApplication: Receive one line as mercy before turning it into a performance review. Let this line guide the first honest return after the reaction.
